needed.evidence: The right side consists of a dirt/paved area heavily blocked by stalls and merchandise, lacking a purpose-built sidewalk.
needed.suggestion: Construct a dedicated, unobstructed sidewalk on the right side of the street to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

needed.evidence: Market stalls and merchandise completely block the pedestrian area on the right.
needed.suggestion: Implement regulations to ensure market stalls do not block the pedestrian walkway.

needed.evidence: The sidewalk surface on the left appears uneven and broken in several places.
needed.suggestion: Repair the broken and uneven sections of the sidewalk on the left side to improve safety.

needed.evidence: Pedestrians are crossing the road between shops and stalls, but there is no designated crossing facility.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing to provide a safe and designated point for people to cross the street.

needed.evidence: Pedestrians are crossing the road in an uncontrolled manner amidst traffic and obstructions.
needed.suggestion: Introduce a signalised or raised crossing to improve pedestrian safety and driver awareness.
